# Stickman Pack license and attribution

The files in this folder are adapted from **Stickman Pack** by **OctoPyte**:
<https://octopyte.itch.io/stickman-pack>.

The pack is offered under the
[Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International license](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).
The creator's paid-download terms also permit commercial and non-commercial
project use and waive the credit requirement for purchasers. DACK retains this
attribution to preserve provenance for downstream users.

The DACK prototype uses the thin idle, run, and jump frames for the playable
character and permits users to modify a 32 x 32 live sprite-pad model.
